text: {"lessons":["I should base sells on each stock’s outlook, not on whether I’m below my average cost; a loss alone is not a reason to hold or sell.","Repeatedly adding to positions at higher prices can concentrate risk, so I should check position sizes and the case for each purchase before committing more cash.","A few positive months don’t prove my approach beats the market; I should judge results over a longer period and compare them with a suitable market benchmark."]}
